test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The artist believes that this new collection of paintings / has being / a masterpiece that / will redefine contemporary art.

options.text: The artist believes that this new collection of paintings

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of "**has being**" which is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be "**has been**" to properly convey the present perfect tense.
 
• The phrase should read "**has been** a masterpiece", ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The artist believes that this new collection of paintings **has been** a masterpiece that will redefine contemporary art."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "The artist believes that this new collection of paintings," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "a masterpiece that"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "will redefine contemporary art."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
